title: How memory works: listen and type

items.text: The brain stores new words while we sleep.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Мозг сохраняет новые слова, пока мы спим.

items.text: Right now, she is memorizing a list of irregular verbs.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Прямо сейчас она запоминает список неправильных глаголов.

items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

items.text: We were revising when the lights went out.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Мы повторяли материал, когда погас свет.

items.text: Scientists have discovered how the brain forms memories.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Учёные выяснили, как мозг формирует воспоминания.

items.text: Do you usually recall names easily?
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

items.text: A familiar smell can trigger an old memory.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Знакомый запах может вызвать старое воспоминание.

items.text: He has never forgotten his first English teacher.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Он никогда не забывал свою первую учительницу английского.

items.text: Neurons connect with each other to form a huge network.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Нейроны соединяются друг с другом и образуют огромную сеть.

items.text: Was he listening when the teacher explained the rule?
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Он слушал, когда учитель объяснял правило?
